scenes: Four to five weeks. That's how long the Iran war was supposed to take. It's been two hundred forty-seven days.
February twenty-eighth, twenty twenty-six. U S and Israeli strikes hit Iran.
The next day, Trump says: 'We intended four to five weeks.'
March ninth: 'Soon. Very soon.' Oil had spiked above one hundred ten dollars. It falls back to the mid-80s.
April seventh: a two-week ceasefire. Bitcoin jumps two point six percent in one hour.
June: a deal is 'two or three days' away.
July eighth: the ceasefire is 'over.' Bitcoin drops to sixty-two thousand.
September: the war 'will end immediately after our election.'
November first: 'We'll put it away very soon.'
We counted every time on the record. At least thirty times, he said the end was near.
Every time, the market listened. Trump now says those weeks meant the nuclear threat.
Day two hundred forty-seven. No final deal.
Markets move on words. Your money should move on facts. Follow Chain Secrets.
